name: Multi-tenant SaaS Developer
summary: Builds product features that must never cross tenant boundaries even for powerful roles.
description: Implements SaaS features where tenant isolation is non-negotiable. Uses core.authorize with high-priority tenant-mismatch deny rules so an admin in tenant A cannot read tenant B resources.

distinguished_from.how: Consumes isolation policy in app features; does not own the platform-wide authz engine itself.
Works on the multi-tenant product backend/policy wiring, not client SDK error-surface integration.
